title: Service Delivery Technician I
description:
The Service Delivery Technician provides direct support to and is a central point of contact for CyrusOne clients. The Service Delivery Technician answers and records calls, e-mail requests and alerts from monitoring platforms, resolves client issues, opens and takes ownership of problems and opens changes. The position also handles fulfilling the requests that are phoned or emailed in which consists of non-complex IT tasks and facility requests.

Job Description

Essential Functions:  

  • Manage shipping and receiving operations, including accepting inbound customer shipments, labeling, and processing materials accurately

  • Load and unload trucks using pallet jacks and assist with occasional forklift use (if trained)

  • Record shipment data such as weight, charges, and tracking details; maintain accurate shipping/receiving reports

  • Monitor and manage ticket queues and email requests, ensuring timely updates and resolution within SLAs

  • Support internal material movement and inventory management across the data center

  • Assist with inventory tasks including tracking enclosures, cage materials, cabling, tools, and other supplies

  •  Help maintain cleanliness and organization of loading dock and storage areas (including waste removal)

  • Provide escort support for customers and visitors within the facility

  • Assist with basic technical tasks such as racking and stacking servers under guidance (Tech II support)

  • Perform tape rotation/exchange and other operational support tasks as required

  • Collaborate with team members in a dynamic environment where priorities may shift quickly

What We Are Looking For:

Required

  • • Strong customer service mindset with the ability to interact professionally with internal teams and customers

  • • Ability to work in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment with shifting priorities

  • • Good communication skills (verbal and written)

  • • Basic computer skills (email, ticketing systems, spreadsheets, etc.)

  • • Willingness to learn and take initiative without needing constant direction

  • • Flexibility with schedule, including occasional shift adjustments (e.g., 2pm–10pm coverage)

  • • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform physical tasks (standing, walking, bending)

Work Environment:

  • Location: Wood Dale, IL

  • Hours: 7:00am-4:00pm, Monday-Friday (Occasional OT as needed).

  • Team Environment: Small, collaborative team

  • Physically active role involving lifting, walking and working on loading dock

  • Must be able to accomplish all physical requirements and activities applicable to the role.

               

Education:

  • Minimum education requirement of High-School diploma or GED equivalent. College degree preferred but will consider applicants with equivalent work-related experience

Why Join Us?:

  • Be part of the rapidly growing data center industry powering the world’s digital infrastructure

  • Collaborative environment focused on commitment, accountability, respect and excellence 

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans, life and disability insurance, access to mental health resources and employee assistance program

  • Competitive pay, performance bonus, 401(k) retirement plan with company match

  • Generous paid time off and holidays

  • Opportunity to break into the data center industry with hands-on experience

  • Clear pathway for growth into more technical roles (e.g., Tech II)

  • Collaborative team environment with strong support and training

  • Exposure to mission-critical operations supporting customer infrastructure

Hourly Rate: $23-$26/hr
